name: nyc-trips
label: Built by Claude Opus 5.5 (separate session)
title: A day of New York taxis
takeaway: Nine in ten trips start within 4 miles of Times Square, but the airports earn almost three times their share of the fares. The city's centre rides at lunchtime, and the rings around it ride after midnight.
provocations: The story is carried by a single moving object or playhead the reader can follow.
Let the reader's pointer reveal a hidden layer (a lens, a scrubber, a split view).
usage_note: Separate interactive session in the playground (medium effort), including two follow-up messages.
